scripts.check: go vet ./... && go build ./... && npm test
scripts.test:sdk: go build -o bin/friendo ./cli/cmd/friendo/ && node tests/sdk-persona.mjs && node tests/sdk-map.mjs && node tests/sdk-map-aggregate.mjs && node tests/sdk-form.mjs && node tests/sdk-network.mjs
scripts.build: npm run admin && npm run sdk && go build -o bin/friendo ./cli/cmd/friendo/
scripts.serve: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo serve
scripts.serve:open: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo serve --open-admin
scripts.network: npm run build && ./bin/friendo network serve --root ./network --base-domain localhost
scripts.export: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo export --mode static
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo push --dry-run
scripts.deploy:www: npm run build && cd www && ../bin/friendo deploy www --network https://friendo.world
scripts.deploy:docs: npm run build && cd docs && ../bin/friendo deploy docs --network https://friendo.world
